title: Drone Intelligence
features:
🛰️ Drone Intelligence V4.2 - Advanced Tactical Scanner
Drone Intelligence V4.2 is a high-tech reconnaissance script designed to give players a massive tactical advantage. It features a smart autonomous drone equipped with a laser-targeting system and a real-time Intel-Tag HUD that identifies and tracks nearby threats.
📜 Key Features
Active Laser Tracking: Automatically locks a high-visibility red laser onto the nearest player within a 60-stud radius.
Intel-Tag V4 HUD: Displays a floating interface above the target's head containing their Username, HP status, and Distance from you.
Visual Health Bar: Includes a dynamic health bar that changes color (Green → Yellow → Red) based on the target's remaining health.
Full ESP Integration: The Intel-Tag is set to AlwaysOnTop, allowing you to see target data even through walls and obstacles.
✅ Pros (ข้อดี)
Superior Awareness: Gain instant information about enemies' health and exact location before engaging in combat.
Zero Character Interference: The drone uses Anchored and CanCollide = false logic, ensuring it never bumps into you or causes physics glitches.
Smooth Interpolation: Movement is handled via Lerp, providing a cinematic and stable following motion that doesn't jitter.
Mobile Optimized: Lightweight code execution makes it perfect for executors like Delta, Hydrogen, or Fluxus on mobile devices.
❌ Cons (ข้อเสีย)
Client-Side Only: All visuals, including the laser and the Intel-Tag, are only visible to you; other players cannot see your drone or its target.
Single Target Focus: The scanner only locks onto the one closest player at a time; it does not track multiple people simultaneously.
Non-Combatant: The drone is purely for intelligence gathering and does not deal damage or fire actual projectiles.
